searchText: I've no strong opinion, but if theres always going to be 9 0's at the end it seems annoying... Since consensus block value is equivalent to the `total` from block rewards endpoint which uses gwei, it would be a little weird to have the discrepancy of using two different units to represent the same value. I agree with <@680234424037670912> that having 9 0s is annoying. Maybe it's better to have EL value in gwei instead since this is a CL endpoint. Awesome, thanks for the input I'll open a spec PR for this tomorrow I'd be more inclined to make booth values in the endpoint Wei, as that keeps precision at the EL. We won't be able to use 64-bit uints any more, but that's the only real downside. both are kind of footguns what about using gwei for both? Hmmm I am unsure how important is the additional precision from wei to the users of this endpoint. Maybe someone can educate me. ~~there's no added precision, it would just be multiplying a gwei value by a billion for consistency~~ Using gwei for the EL value loses the additional precision, and potentially creates a truncation/rounding confusion. It's not something I care too deeply about, the values should be used for broad comparison purposes only, but if we have the precision I'd prefer to keep it. And it follows that we move the CL value to gwei for consistency. oh yeah sorry, brainfart on my part <@&595685821026271242> scam above Thanks, this makes sense. excerpts.author: nc1234
excerpts.content: Since consensus block value is equivalent to the `total` from block rewards endpoint which uses gwei, it would be a little weird to have the discrepancy of using two different units to represent the same value. I agree with <@680234424037670912> that having 9 0s is annoying. Maybe it's better to have EL value in gwei instead since this is a CL endpoint.

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: I'd be more inclined to make booth values in the endpoint Wei, as that keeps precision at the EL. We won't be able to use 64-bit uints any more, but that's the only real downside.

both are kind of footguns

what about using gwei for both?

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content: ~~there's no added precision, it would just be multiplying a gwei value by a billion for consistency~~

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content:
Using gwei for the EL value loses the additional precision, and potentially creates a truncation/rounding confusion.

It's not something I care too deeply about, the values should be used for broad comparison purposes only, but if we have the precision I'd prefer to keep it. And it follows that we move the CL value to gwei for consistency.
